capabilities: Colour note and folder titles from the right-click menu
Define custom states with a colour, a front matter value and a meaning
Write the chosen state into the note's front matter field
Apply one-off custom colours with a palette and eyedropper
Clear colours left behind by notes deleted outside Obsidian
extras: Ships with four default states (open, done, needs-testing, archived) that can be renamed or deleted; manual installs of pre-release builds do not self-update.
motivation: The author built it because colour without recorded meaning decays into decoration, and a colouring system maintained by hand quietly stops being true.
problem: A file explorer of grey titles shows nothing about note status, and colouring titles by hand with CSS snippets or front matter edits is too much upkeep to keep doing.

relations.evidence: Other tools can read it, Dataview can query it, and a snippet can style it.

summary: File explorer plugin that colours note and folder titles from a right-click menu, using user-defined states stored in front matter.
